This was the worst experience of my life, and it happened on my second day in Cyprus. We moved from the UK and brought our UK-registered car. The law says if you transfer your residence from outside the EU, you can import without VAT or taxes, and if the car is over 5 years old, this is the only way.

At the Limassol Customs car import office, the highest-ranking officer refused our application. She wrongly said we can’t apply because we are Hungarian, not British, even though the law doesn’t require you to be a citizen of the country you move from. She didn’t listen, interrupted constantly, waved me off mid-sentence, and left me standing there.

We gave her all documents to prove we moved from the UK, including HMRC tax documents marked “copy only,” which she didn’t understand and called “drafts.” She clearly didn’t know the difference and her English was very poor. We offered to let our bookkeeper explain it, or to call HMRC. She refused.

We also gave her an official letter from HMRC confirming our stay in the UK. She still said it wasn’t enough and demanded bank statements. When she saw Hungarian transactions, she said we lived in Hungary, ignoring the fact HMRC confirmed UK residency. No matter what we showed, she came up with a new reason to say no.

We were at the office from morning until late afternoon. Another customs officer told us she’s the boss, has no direct superior in Limassol, and if she’s having a bad day, it’s her decision. It really felt like abuse of power and possible corruption.

After sending her even our flight tickets, she still only gave us a 30-day temporary import without explanation. At the car registration office, we were told we can’t challenge her decision for 8 months, while the car can only stay 30 days.

I paid over €3000 to bring the car here, €150 to release it, and now will likely pay €3000 to take it back. Over €6000 lost because of this broken and bureaucratic system.

To anyone thinking of bringing a car to Cyprus, be very careful.

And to the officer involved,
I truly hope no one ever treats you the way you treated us. You need to remember that for many people, you are the first person they meet when moving to Cyprus. First, there is no direct route between Paralimni and Limassol. While I understand that demand may not justify a direct connection, the coordination between routes is extremely poor. The arrival time of the Paralimni–Larnaca bus often coincides almost exactly with the departure time of the Larnaca–Limassol bus. Missing the connection by just a few minutes means waiting up to 1.5 hours for the next bus, which is simply unacceptable for a service like this.

To make matters worse, due to ongoing roadworks, the main stop has been moved from Finikoudes to Nikolaides. This temporary arrangement has been in place for months, yet there is still no proper infrastructure,no seating, no shelter from the sun or rain. Passengers, including elderly people, children, and workers who have had a long day, are left standing in uncomfortable and sometimes harsh conditions.

Overall, it feels like there is very little consideration for passengers. Ticket prices continue to rise, but the quality of service does not reflect this. Better scheduling coordination and basic improvements to waiting conditions would make a significant difference.

They advised me that it would be at the destination on Thursday, that's today.

Today 3 days after, they called me to ask me what was in the envelope!! And that it wouldn't arrive until next week now.

How on earth can you explain this to anybody? Only in Cyprus!

This is not the kind of courier service you expect for €31!
Shameful service.

UPDATE
Credit should be given where it’s due.
In Cyprus, in my personal experience complaints generally do not receive a prompt and constructive response, so it is only fair to acknowledge when a complaint is handled properly.

I initially left a negative review because the original handling of this shipment was poor.
However, after sending my complaint on Saturday, both ACS and DHL responded very quickly, contacted me directly, investigated the matter, apologised, and confirmed that a full refund would be issued.
The original issue should never have happened, but both ACS and DHL deserve credit for the speed and professionalism with which they then dealt with the matter.
I am therefore updating my review in the interests of fairness.

But let’s be real—they’ve done more than enough to lose the rest.

This post office has gone from reliable to a complete disaster.

Back in 2022, I had two packages headed to my doorstep. Tracked them obsessively, made sure I was home—and they just vanished. No knock, no slip, no explanation. Just gone. Then in 2023, I placed five more orders. Know how many actually showed up? One. The rest disappeared like it’s standard procedure. I paid for home delivery, not for my stuff to fall into a black hole.

And what do you get when your package doesn’t show? Nothing. No updates, no notifications, no “sorry we missed you”—just radio silence. Meanwhile, I’m stuck at home wasting my time, wondering if I’m crazy for expecting the bare minimum. This isn’t delivery, it’s a gamble.

I used to recommend this place. Now? I warn people to avoid it. It’s inconsistent, it’s sloppy, and it’s a total headache. I’m tired of paying for a service that clearly no longer exists.

Title: 19-Day Delivery Failure + Complete Incompetence – UPS Partner G.A.P. Vassilopoulos Destroyed My Order
Ordered an item on 21 November 2025 from Gomibo (Netherlands).
UPS tracking: 1Z2F540RD992177087 (UPS Express Saver – supposedly next-day in Cyprus).
Package arrived in Cyprus on 4 December 2025 at 09:21 AM in Aradippou facility.
Since then: NOTHING. Zero delivery attempts to Paralimni (30 minutes away).
Tracking shows the same package has been “Out for Delivery” and “Rescheduled” at least 5 times in 6 days (4 Dec, 5 Dec, 9 Dec, etc.).
Every time I call G.A.P. Vassilopoulos Paralimni/Famagusta they promise “today” or “tomorrow” and then ghost me. No driver ever shows up, no call, no explanation.
As of 10 December 2025 the package is still sitting somewhere in your network with the message “Delivery date will be provided as soon as possible.”
That is 19 days after the original order and 6 full days after it cleared customs in Cyprus – for a 30-minute drive to Paralimni.
This is not a one-off: dozens of recent Google reviews here mention the exact same problem – packages stuck for weeks in Paralimni area, drivers who never arrive, and customer service that lies daily.
G.A.P. Vassilopoulos is single-handedly destroying UPS reputation in Cyprus and costing online shops thousands of euros in refunds and lost customers.
If you live in Famagusta district, avoid any company that uses G.A.P./UPS – use ACS, DHL or anyone else.

Είναι ένα δίκτυο από μεγάλες, έξυπνες μεταλλικές «ντουλάπες» (τα BOX NOW Lockers) που βρίσκονται σε χιλιάδες σημεία. Δεν χρειάζεται να πας σε κατάστημα ταχυμεταφορών και να κάνεις ουρά
Παίρνεις SMS με 6ψήφιο κωδικό → πας στο locker → πληκτρολογείς τον κωδικό → ανοίγει η θυρίδα σου → παίρνεις το δέμα. Δέχονται δέματα μέχρι ~20 kg και συγκεκριμένες διαστάσεις (small / medium / large θυρίδες)
Συνεργάζεται με χιλιάδες e-shops (πάνω από 7.000)

Δύσκολη στάθμευση: Συχνά δεν υπάρχει ελεύθερο παρκάρισμα ακριβώς δίπλα.

Πολύ οικονομικά μεταφορικά σε σχέση με παράδοση στην πόρτα. Το Box Now έχει γίνει must-have για όποιον ψωνίζει online συχνά.
Γιατί μπορεί να είναι λίγο άβολο:

Δύσκολη στάθμευση: Συχνά δεν υπάρχει ελεύθερο παρκάρισμα ακριβώς δίπλα.
Κίνηση & ασφάλεια: Σε διασταύρωση με φανάρια, μπορεί να είναι επικίνδυνο να σταματήσεις γρήγορα, να κατέβεις, να πάρεις το δέμα και να φύγεις.
Χρόνος: Αν πας ώρες αιχμής, η αναμονή για θέση μπορεί να σε εκνευρίσει.
Χρησιμοποίησε το BOX NOW App ή τον Locker Finder: Βάλε την ακριβή σου διεύθυνση ή Τ.Κ. και δες όλα τα lockers γύρω σου (σε ακτίνα 500m–1km). Πολλές φορές υπάρχουν εναλλακτικά lockers σε πιο ήσυχες γειτονιές, σε parking σούπερ μάρκετ (π.χ. , Lidl,  βενζινάδικα ή εμπορικά κέντρα) κοντά, όπου το παρκάρισμα είναι πολύ πιο εύκολο (συνήθως δωρεάν για λίγα λεπτά).
Επίλεξε locker με καλύτερο parking: Στο app δείχνει και φωτογραφίες/περιγραφές σημείων – προτίμησε αυτά σε μεγάλα καταστήματα ή με ιδιωτικό χώρο στάθμευσης.
Πήγαινε off-peak: Πρωί νωρίς, μεσημέρι ή αργά το βράδυ (αφού είναι 24/7) – η κίνηση πέφτει και βρίσκεις εύκολα θέση.","text_translated":"Box Now is the most popular (and fastest growing) automated locker service for receiving and sending parcels. It is a network of large, smart metal “lockers” (BOX NOW Lockers) located in thousands of locations. You receive your parcel 24 hours a day – 7 days a week (including Sundays and holidays!)
No need to wait for a courier or be home at a specific time
No need to go to a courier store and queue
You receive an SMS with a 6-digit code → go to the locker → type in the code → your locker opens → you receive the parcel. They accept parcels up to ~20 kg and specific dimensions (small / medium / large lockers)
Cooperates with thousands of e-shops (over 7,000)
You can also send a parcel from locker to locker (very convenient for second-hand items, sales, etc.)
Very economical shipping compared to door delivery. Box Now has become a must-have for anyone who shops online frequently.
Why it can be a little inconvenient:

Difficult parking: There is often no free parking right next door.
Traffic & safety: At an intersection with traffic lights, it can be dangerous to stop quickly, get out, pick up the parcel and leave.
Time: If you go during peak hours, waiting for a space can be annoying.
Use the BOX NOW App or Locker Finder: Enter your exact address or ZIP code and see all the lockers around you (within a radius of 500m–1km). There are often alternative lockers in quieter neighborhoods, in supermarket parking lots (e.g., Lidl, gas stations or shopping centers) nearby, where parking is much easier (usually free for a few minutes).
Choose a locker with better parking: The app also shows photos/descriptions of spots – prefer those in large stores or with private parking.
Go off-peak: Early morning, midday or late evening (since it is 24/7) – traffic drops and you can easily find a spot.","published_at":"2026-03-02T09:53:34.277406Z"}]
